positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: how does the remember contract work as an immediate-return, non-blocking async design?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same binding technical commitment about the async remember contract in native pipeline vocabulary: src-1 ratifies it as settled terms (receipt in seconds, cursor polling, no blocking, no lost work if receipt dropped), src-2 records the key decision (dispatch, then poll or piggyback reaction on a later call). The register read spans both as maxims; conviction is decision-grade in both. No tension — the second elaborates the first's retrieval paths under the same contract.
